_**Agent (gpt-5.4 2026-05-12 09:08:51Z)**_

`main` on `origin` has commits your local `main` does not, so Git rejected the push to avoid overwriting remote history.

Safest fix:
```bash
git pull --rebase origin main
# resolve any conflicts, then
git push origin main
```

Use this only if you intentionally rewrote history and want to replace the remote branch:
```bash
git push --force-with-lease origin main
```
